steps.command: cd /workspace && ls -la && echo '---QUERY---' && cat my-sql-query.sql && echo '---SCHEMA---' && sqlite3 oewn.sqlite '.schema'

cd /workspace
sqlite3 oewn.sqlite ".indexes"
echo '---counts---'
sqlite3 oewn.sqlite "SELECT 'words', COUNT(*) FROM words UNION ALL SELECT 'senses', COUNT(*) FROM senses UNION ALL SELECT 'synsets', COUNT(*) FROM synsets;"

cd /workspace
sqlite3 oewn.sqlite "SELECT type,name,tbl_name,sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='index' ORDER BY tbl_name;"
echo '---plan---'
timeout 30 sqlite3 oewn.sqlite "EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN $(cat my-sql-query.sql)" || echo PLAN_TIMEOUT

cd /workspace
sqlite3 oewn.sqlite "select sqlite_version();"
sqlite3 oewn.sqlite "SELECT COUNT(*) total, COUNT(DISTINCT wordid) distinct_ids FROM words;"
sqlite3 oewn.sqlite "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT wordid,word FROM words GROUP BY wordid,word HAVING COUNT(*)>1);"
sqlite3 oewn.sqlite "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT wordid,synsetid,COUNT(*) c FROM senses GROUP BY wordid,synsetid HAVING c>1);"
sqlite3 oewn.sqlite "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM senses s LEFT JOIN synsets sy ON sy.synsetid=s.synsetid WHERE sy.synsetid IS NULL;"

cd /workspace
cat > /tmp/sol1.sql <<'SQL'
WITH ss AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT s.wordid, s.synsetid, COUNT(*) AS sense_count,
         syn.domainid, syn.posid
  FROM senses s
  JOIN synsets syn ON syn.synsetid = s.synsetid
  GROUP BY s.wordid, s.synsetid
),
ws AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT wordid,
         COUNT(*) AS total_synsets,
         SUM(sense_count) AS total_senses,
         COUNT(DISTINCT domainid) AS distinct_domains,
         COUNT(DISTINCT posid) AS distinct_posids
  FROM ss
  GROUP BY wordid
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
     AND COUNT(DISTINCT domainid) >= 2
     AND SUM(sense_count) >= 2
),
ranked AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT ss.wordid, ss.synsetid, ss.sense_count,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ss.wordid ORDER BY ss.sense_count DESC, ss.synsetid ASC) AS rn
  FROM ss
  JOIN ws ON ws.wordid = ss.wordid
)
SELECT ws.wordid AS word_id,
       w.word AS word,
       ws.total_synsets,
       ws.total_senses,
       ws.distinct_domains,
       ws.distinct_posids,
       r.synsetid AS top_synsetid,
       r.sense_count AS top_synset_sense_count
FROM ws
JOIN words w ON w.wordid = ws.wordid
JOIN ranked r ON r.wordid = ws.wordid AND r.rn = 1
ORDER BY ws.total_senses DESC,
         ws.total_synsets DESC,
         ws.distinct_domains DESC,
         ws.wordid ASC
LIMIT 500;
SQL
echo '---plan---'
sqlite3 oewn.sqlite "EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN $(cat /tmp/sol1.sql)"
echo '---time---'
time sqlite3 oewn.sqlite < /tmp/sol1.sql > /tmp/sol1.out
wc -l /tmp/sol1.out
head -5 /tmp/sol1.out

python3 - <<'PY'
import sqlite3,time,hashlib
con=sqlite3.connect('oewn.sqlite')
for f in ['current','variantB','variantC']:
    sql=open('/tmp/'+f+'.sql').read()
    con.execute(sql).fetchall()
    times=[]
    for _ in range(5):
        t=time.perf_counter(); rows=con.execute(sql).fetchall(); times.append(time.perf_counter()-t)
    print(f, min(times), sum(times)/len(times), hashlib.sha256(repr(rows).encode()).hexdigest())
